subject: Music Production
title: Creative Commons and Sample Packs
description: A micro-lesson that makes Creative Commons and Sample Packs usable.

hook.text: Creative Commons licenses let artists share their recordings for others to sample legally and freely.

buildup.text: Online platforms host millions of royalty-free loops, one-shots, and stems for producers to use.

discovery.text: Commercial sample packs provide pre-cleared sounds that producers can use without legal worry.

twist.text: Some top-charting songs are built entirely from sample packs costing less than thirty dollars.

climax.text: Free and affordable sample libraries have democratized music production for creators worldwide.

punchline.text: Thirty-dollar sample packs power million-stream hits.

quiz.question: What do Creative Commons licenses allow in music?
options: Free use of any copyrighted song
Artists to share recordings for others to sample legally
